body:
## Pull request overview

Adds missing Zod `.describe()` annotations across the marketplace lifecycle protocol schemas to improve generated JSON Schema / docs, and expands ROADMAP tracking for remaining runtime implementation work.

**Changes:**
- Added `.describe()` to previously-undescribed enums and multiple field-level schema properties in kernel and cloud marketplace protocols.
- Added `.describe()` at request/response schema level for clearer API contract documentation.
- Expanded ROADMAP section 8.5 with a more granular “Plugin marketplace runtime” checklist.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts | Adds `.describe()` to upgrade-related enums and usage sites for better generated docs. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts | Adds `.describe()` to package status enum plus installed package + request/response fields and schema-level descriptions. |
| packages/spec/src/cloud/marketplace.zod.ts | Adds `.describe()` to publisher/listing enums and remaining listing field descriptions (URLs, pricing, etc.). |
| ROADMAP.md | Expands section 8.5 with sub-items for CLI/runtime/API/Studio/cloud implementation tracking. |
